clearest_gap.note: Nobody buys takaful on impulse. They search what hibah means, what a medical card covers, and what happens if they claim - and none of those searches can currently find you.

findings.title: Three products named, none explained
findings.client_summary: Nobody buys takaful on impulse. The questions people research before choosing an adviser currently have no page to land on.

findings.title: One page competes for every search
findings.client_summary: A single page can only compete for one kind of search, however good it is.

findings.title: No proof anywhere - no testimonials, licence, or track record
findings.client_summary: There is nowhere a visitor can see that anyone has trusted you before. For a decision this personal, that is the missing piece.

findings.title: Site answers at two addresses with no redirect
findings.client_summary: Your site exists at two addresses at once, so Google has to guess which is real - and the value splits between them.

findings.title: Caching disabled; slow first response
findings.client_summary: Pages take noticeably longer to start loading than they should, and nothing is stored for repeat visitors.

findings.title: No social share preview card
findings.client_summary: When your link is shared on WhatsApp, no preview card appears - every share is less persuasive than it should be.

findings.title: Google Business Profile could not be confirmed
findings.client_summary: Whether you appear on the Google map for advisers near you could not be confirmed from outside.

findings.title: Recruitment section sits before the closing call to action
findings.client_summary: Someone weighing protection for their family meets a job advert before they reach your closing message.

findings.title: Only one photograph on the entire site
findings.client_summary: One professional photo carries the whole brand; the sessions and people behind it have no visual presence.

findings.title: Five button styles for a handful of actions
findings.client_summary: Small inconsistencies in buttons make choosing feel harder than it should at the moment of action.
